activity.evidenceTitle: Navigating Current Events — A Message from Elan — January 2026
activity.notes: Confirmed as a dated original-content claim on the official site within 2025-10-22 through 2026-10-22. The page attributes an exchange to Elan in January 2026; it does not expose a recording, an exact day or independently establish supernatural origin. This differs from the two indexed historical YouTube archive releases. Andrew remains first-name-only; exact channeler attribution for this particular text is not restated on the page.

findings: Nine account records include six primary official account/archive identities plus three additional authorized Kryon distribution accounts; April's uploader account remains unresolved.
Fourteen individual videos cover seven assigned profiles. Four exact upload dates come from exposed YouTube Published metadata; remaining dates are null.

Account identity verification and individual-video uploader verification are separate. Null accountId means the individual uploader was not independently exposed, even when an official site supplied the video.
Abraham, the Guides, Sanaya and VERONICA are indexed as nonphysical/spirit-guide claims, not converted into extraterrestrial species. Kryon is described as angelic.

Andrew is attributed by first name only. The two indexed Elan YouTube recordings remain archive releases. Separately, official text dates an exchange with Elan to January 2026 and supports annual original-content activity at month precision.
Metadata and official catalog descriptions were inspected; no claim is made to have watched full recordings, reviewed full transcripts or verified supernatural claims.
